title: Sarle's bimodality coefficient — bimodality.coefficient
text: Computes Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) numeric sample, fast moment-based screen bimodality: $$BC = (g^2 + 1) / (k + 3 (n-1)^2 / ((n-2)(n-3)))$$ \(g\) sample skewness \(k\) sample excess kurtosis. BC lies (0, 1]; benchmark 5/9 (0.555) value uniform distribution, larger values indicate bimodal shape. BC moment-based diagnostic can complement dip-test evidence retained fastINFLECT. deliberately default QC statistic: driven skewness kurtosis can flag heavy-tailed strongly skewed single-mode markers (common cytometry) bimodal. Use rank marker-cluster pairs follow-explicit distributional tests plots.

Rcpp accelerates IQR-spread test p-value interpolation. Validated pure-R paths remain available compiled code unavailable. Subtrees scored row index, one marker time, instead copying full events--markers matrix every subtree. max.events.per.node can cap event retention sensitivity analyses. SOM node sampled seed, retained rows feed every marker, criterion, metaclustering, worker. Provenance records original retained event counts.
